highlight: Only 2,634 hours, MSP Gold, HUD, winglets, fresh Duncan inspections.
overview:
This 2008 Falcon 900EX EASy shows exceptionally low time at 2,633.8 hours and 1,566 landings, with all three TFE731-60-1C engines and the APU on MSP Gold. She's currently completing a major inspection package at Duncan Aviation Lincoln — 12M through 36M, 1C and 3C — all complied with January 2026. Tracked on TRAXXALL, operated Part 91/135.

The Honeywell EASy II Primus EPIC suite is Cert 4 with Collins HUD, WAAS/LPV, FANS 1/A, CPDLC, and TCAS 3000, plus Aviation Partners blended winglets. The 14-passenger cabin was completed by Duncan in July 2014 on a three-year refresh cycle, with forward club, mid conference group, and dual aft divans, Gogo AVANCE L3 Wi-Fi, Collins Venue CMS, and Rosen HD monitors. Snow white exterior with black velvet and ice silver.
